# Matteo Bianco — CRM & Tech Project Manager, AI & Automation Builder

> Matteo Bianco is a CRM & Tech Project Manager and AI & Automation Builder based in Bari, Italy, with 6+ years of experience across retail, luxury kidswear, FMCG, SaaS, pharma, MedTech and insurance. He connects business goals, data and technology to deliver CRM ecosystems, automations and digital products, from discovery to release: requirements, process design, customer journeys, integrations, testing, adoption and measurement.

Site: https://www.mb-personal-branding.it/ (Italian) and https://www.mb-personal-branding.it/en (English). Sitemap: https://www.mb-personal-branding.it/sitemap.xml

## Highlights

- €2M in incremental sales at approximately 20 times MROI from CRM and loyalty campaigns at Maiora / Despar Centro Sud, achieved with the marketing, ecommerce, IT and operations teams.
- +100% year-over-year growth in Glovo quick-commerce revenue at Maiora; end-to-end launch of the Just Eat partnership (€10K co-marketing investment); SAP Emarsys migration from negotiation to rollout kickoff.
- Spoki: marketing and process automation during the company phase that led to a €5.5M Series A and 3x revenue growth (company outcomes, contributed to as part of the team).
- Roche Italy: Salesforce Health Cloud administration, Italian go-live of the Classic-to-Lightning migration, UAT and Field Service iPad training.
- Deloitte for Johnson & Johnson MedTech: requirements and three RPA bots for Tender Offices in three countries.
- NasciTara: a web app that combines data from multiple ultrasound scans and shows estimated weight, length, percentile and growth trajectory. For informational purposes only; it does not replace medical reports, opinions or consultations. Live at https://nascitara.vercel.app/.
